title: A Fourth-Century A.D. Tomb at Beit Fajjar (with a note on the lamps by J. H. Iliffe)
author: S. A. S. Husseini; J. H. Iliffe
location_note: Rock ridge Tor Abu Ruwaa, west of Beit Fajjar; no map reference; placed by name. p. 178 inferred (unnumbered last text leaf before the plates).
notes: Cleared July 1934 after discovery in building foundations: intact single-chamber tomb reached by a vertical shaft, door slab, six graves under arcosolia, wall niches with lamps; glass, bronze jewellery, amber amulet. Lamps dated to the first third of the 4th century AD (Iliffe).

features.site: Tor Abu Ruwaa, west of Beit Fajjar
features.subtype: shaft-entered rock-cut chamber tomb with six graves under arcosolia and lamp niches, sealed by a door slab
features.period: first third of the fourth century AD (lamps)
features.quote: The graves were excavated in the floor under arcosolia
